factual_claims.source_evidence: Interim Condensed Consolidated Statement of Changes in Equity: Total equity at 30 June 2026: EUR 367,677k (367.677 million) vs 368,700k (368.700 million) at 31 December 2025 (−0.3%). The minor decrease is framed as 'stable' in context.

factual_claims.claim: The Group invested EUR 3.5 million in capital expenditures, a significant decrease from EUR 12.0 million in the prior year period.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Investments section: 'In the first 6 months of 2026, the Group invested EUR 3.5 million, which is EUR 8.5 million less than in the same period last year.'

factual_claims.claim: Net finance costs decreased by 11.2% due to lower debt levels.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Interim Condensed Consolidated Statement of Comprehensive Income: Net finance costs decreased by EUR 0.3 million (−11.2%) in the first 6 months of the year due to lower interest expense on loans and borrowings resulting from the lower level of debt.

factual_claims.claim: The company paid a dividend of EUR 19.2 million in the second quarter, consistent with the previous year.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Dividends section: 'On 28 April 2026, the annual general meeting of shareholders approved the proposal of the management board to distribute a dividend of EUR 0.073 per share and EUR 19.2 million in total... In 2025, we also paid a dividend of EUR 0.073 per share, i.e. EUR 19.2 million in total.'

factual_claims.claim: Management noted that global economic instability and geopolitical conflicts pose risks, particularly regarding fuel costs and cargo flows, although the Group remains compliant with all sanctions and financial covenants.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Main Economic Risks section: Discusses instability from US-Iran conflict, Russia-Ukraine war, and sanctions compliance. Management Report confirms compliance with EU sanctions and covenant adherence.
